name: joust_through_hits_an_attacker_for_exactly_three_and_its_caster_gains_one
notes: Printed: 'Joust Through deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. You gain 1 life.' Seat 0 attacks with a 3/3 and a 4/4 into an empty board. In the declare-attackers window seat 1 (the defender, the caster) casts one Joust Through at the 3/3 and one at the 4/4, each with a tapped Plains. 3 damage kills the 3/3 and only marks the 4/4 (3 damage, still alive), so the damage is exactly 3. Each cast gains the caster 1 life: seat 1 ends at 20 + 1 + 1 - 4 (the surviving 4/4 is unblocked) = 18, seat 0 stays at 20. Only the targeted attacker is hit (the other is left alone by the first cast).
